Yuddhajayārṇava
This appears to be a tantrik work treating of Pūjā an. similar tantrik topics. This is dated 1306 A. D. in Jayasthiti Malla's reign. It is a work on svarodaya in 10 Paṭalas. See Nepal I. Preface p. LXX. Though in the form of a. interlocution between Śiva an. Pārvatī, the work is attributed in mss. RASB. VIII. nos. 6109 an. 6110 to Bhaṭṭotpala presumably on account of its astrological character. ment, in Narapatijayacaryā of Narapati. IO. 3109a.q. by Raghunandana (c. 1515-45) in Jyotiṣatattva. National Mus. ND. p.. 9-10.
